title: IGMPv2 Security Considerations and Key Changes from IGMPv1
summary: Section 10 (Security Considerations) of RFC 2236 details how to prevent forged messages that could disrupt IGMP group membership management. Section 13 (Appendix I - Changes from IGMPv1) outlines specific improvements in IGMPv2, including standardizing the querier election mechanism and requiring Router Alert options for enhanced security.

security_measures.threat: Forged Query message causing Querier role assignment or unnecessary traffic
security_measures.impact: Assigns Querier duties to forger; causes temporary loss of membership updates

security_measures.threat: Externally forged v1 Reports causing 'members present' state when there are none
security_measures.impact: Triggers Group-Specific Queries, extra processing, potential traffic loss up to [Group Membership Interval]

security_measures.threat: Forged Reports making multicast routers think members exist on a subnet
security_measures.impact: May cause unnecessary group membership reports from hosts

security_measures.threat: Externally forged Leave messages triggering new queries
security_measures.impact: Extra processing, but no loss of desired traffic; can break Querier state if not handled correctly

security_defenses.description: Ignore messages from sources that do not belong to the local subnet assigned to the receiving interface.
Require IP Router Alert option [RFC 2113] and do not forward Report or Leave messages via routers.
security_defenses.note: Breaking backwards compatibility with implementations that do not support Router Alert

security_defenses.description: Configurable switch to ignore Version 1 messages completely for scenarios where fast leave is critical.

igmpv2_improvements_over_v1.description: Eliminates the need for different mechanisms per multicast routing protocol, though care must be taken when coexisting with IGMPv1 routers
Combines Version and Type fields into a single 'Type' field for easier identification of v1 vs v2 reports
All IGMPv2 packets must include the IP Router Alert option [RFC 2113]
Uses a previously unused field in queries to carry Max Response Time
New message type introduced for IGMPv2 Leave Group handling
